response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), ratio_stats AS (SELECT ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_diff, avg_diff / NULLIF(AVG(avg_diff) OVER (), 0) AS ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_PT, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_IGA_IGM_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM ratio_stats GROUP BY SEX;
